name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1501: Konyo had G5 Grok Eyes set to PRIMARY - his mandated vision lane - and the console reported cliInstalled false, mode off, calls 0, errors 0, last_error none. Nothing was failing because nothing was ever attempted. The cause: shutil.which searches the PATH of THIS process, and the console runs as a GUI app under launchd whose PATH is the bare usr bin - it never inherits the shell PATH where the grok binary lives. control_app already carried _find_claude_bin for exactly this reason; the third eye had no equivalent. It now hunts env overrides, then PATH, then the known install locations, and the card leads with a warning whenever the switch and the effective mode disagree.
